# statusdrift_on_call_policy (Resource)

Manages a StatusDrift on-call escalation policy.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "statusdrift_on_call_policy" "default" {
  name       = "Default Escalation"
  enabled    = true
  is_default = true
  scope_type = "org_default"

  step {
    target_type   = "schedule"
    schedule_id   = statusdrift_on_call_schedule.primary.id
    delay_minutes = 0
  }

  step {
    target_type            = "member"
    organization_member_id = 5
    delay_minutes          = 5
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the on-call policy (max 255 characters).

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the on-call policy is active.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the default organization on-call policy. Only one policy can be default. Only applies to org_default scope.
- `monitor_group_id` (Number) Monitor group ID. Required when scope_type is monitor_group.
- `scope_type` (String) Policy scope: org_default (organization-wide) or monitor_group (group-specific).
- `step` (Block List) Escalation steps, ordered by position. Steps are executed in order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--step))

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The unique identifier of the on-call policy.

<a id="nestedblock--step"></a>
### Nested Schema for `step`

Required:

- `delay_minutes` (Number) Minutes to wait before escalating to this step (0 = immediate).
- `target_type` (String) Target type: schedule (notify current on-call from schedule) or member (notify specific member).

Optional:

- `organization_member_id` (Number) Organization member ID. Required when target_type is member.
- `schedule_id` (Number) On-call schedule ID. Required when target_type is schedule.

Read-Only:

- `position` (Number) Step position (1-indexed), computed from block order.
